ingredients.title: Layer 3
items: 2 pkg (3 oz) Jell-O instant chocolate pudding

ingredients.title: Layer 4
items: Sweetened whipped cream or 1 carton (8 oz) Cool Whip
Chopped nuts and chocolate curls or shavings, if desired

instructions.title: Layer 1
items: Bake in 9x13-inch greased pan in 300°F oven for 25 minutes.

instructions.title: Layer 4
items: Spread remaining Cool Whip over top of 3rd layer, then sprinkle with chopped nuts and chocolate curls or shavings over top, if desired.

If I have to speed up the cooling process for layer one, I put it in the freezer after about 5-10 minutes and it will cool more quickly. Otherwise, it may take about an hour to cool completely at room temperature.

notes.title: Banana delight
items: Substitute banana pudding mix for the chocolate in the recipe. If desired, garnish with banana slices that have been soaked in lemon juice.

notes.title: Coconut delight
items: Substitute coconut pudding and pie filling for chocolate. Spread about 1 cup of coconut on a cookie sheet and bake a few minutes at 350°F until slightly toasted. Sprinkle toasted coconut over top. Refrigerate.

notes.title: Pistachio delight
items: Substitute pistachio pudding and pie filling for the chocolate. Garnish with chopped pistachios.
